Tom — thanks, this is straightforward and we can meet those constraints. Attaching a Phase 1 rollout sheet that maps team -> environment -> API key name. High-level plan below: 

1) Provision keys (T+1 business day) — we create 3 keys, one per app, scoped to Dev + Prod environments.
2) Traffic guardrails (T+1) — default per-key request rate set to 200 req/min; we can tune after the first week.
3) Staggered activation (optional) — recommended: enable Patient Intake on Day 0, Billing Helper Day 3, Clinician Tools Day 7.
4) Monitoring & credits — we’ll enable per-key cost dashboards and a 14-day eval credit buffer for the first month.

Couple items for contract/finance: the aggregate throughput you mentioned stays within your current commitment—no additional committed spend required for Phase 1 unless you opt for reserved capacity. If you'd like us to sign a short amendment to record the new team counts and keys, we can route a one-page addendum.

I’ll loop in Laura (account manager) for the amendment and Monica (ops) for provisioning. Please confirm if you want staggered activation and the initial go-live dates.

Attached: ELR_phase1-rollout-sheet.xlsx

—Jonas
